The molecule profile reports no Lipinski violations, LogP -0.13, TPSA 95.11 Å², and QED 0.496. Its retrieved PubChem/safety section gives an informational safety disclaimer but does not enumerate specific GHS hazard warnings in the output.

For the requested binary ClinTox call, the evidence-supported provisional prediction is ClinTox No (no retrieved clinical-toxicity flag; compound is an approved drug), while recognizing that approval does not mean absence of adverse effects and this is not a substitute for a trained ClinTox model or label-specific toxicity data.
